customer_name: XCMG Excavator (徐州徐工挖掘机械有限公司)
business_problem: XCMG Excavator needed a modern industrial data platform to support product innovation, intelligent services, refined management, and upstream-downstream ecosystem collaboration, because fast business growth made its existing data practices inadequate for digital and intelligent operations.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud built XCMG Excavator's big-data foundation on the Tiansuan platform with a broad product set that spans ingestion, lakehouse-style management, warehousing, visualization, and analytics. EasyDAP provides the central all-in-one data-lake management and analysis layer, covering data integration, governance, development, analysis, and data services in one environment. BMR adds the managed big-data runtime with strong compatibility and operations support, while Sugar BI handles agile visual analysis and dashboards. PALO contributes a real-time MPP data warehouse and Pingo adds a batch-and-stream data factory so the platform can support both periodic and near-real-time industrial analytics. The implementation also included data standards, data aggregation, data development and analysis workflows, multidimensional MPP analysis, visualization reporting, and data-mining applications, all organized in a spiral build-out of data marts for finance, investment, risk control, and wider industrial use cases.

solution_components.name: Tiansuan
solution_components.role: Acts as the umbrella big-data platform that Baidu AI Cloud used to build XCMG Excavator's end-to-end industrial analytics environment.

solution_components.name: EasyDAP
solution_components.role: Provides one-stop data integration, governance, development, analysis, and service capabilities for industrial data-lake workflows.

solution_components.name: BMR
solution_components.role: Supplies the managed big-data platform runtime with compatibility and operations support for platform workloads.

solution_components.name: Sugar BI
solution_components.role: Delivers agile visualization and large-screen analytics for business users.

solution_components.name: PALO
solution_components.role: Provides the MPP real-time data warehouse for multidimensional industrial analytics.

solution_components.name: Pingo
solution_components.role: Handles batch-and-stream data factory workloads so the platform can support continuous industrial data processing.

data_flow: Industrial data from XCMG operations is aggregated and standardized on Tiansuan, integrated and governed through EasyDAP and BMR, stored and analyzed in PALO, processed in batch and stream through Pingo, and then exposed through Sugar BI and downstream data-mining applications for business analysis and risk-warning use cases.
business_outcome: XCMG Excavator established a unified industrial data platform that supports fault prediction, risk warning, management analytics, and broader digital-intelligence upgrades across the company and its ecosystem.
architecture_clues: The build includes data standards, data aggregation, data analysis, MPP multidimensional analytics, visualization, and data-mining applications.
The platform is being expanded through spiral delivery of business-specific data marts rather than a single big-bang rollout.
Batch and streaming analytics are both part of the architecture.
